environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in a Kubernetes pod with Istio service mesh. The Envoy filter chain includes a local rate limiter configured as an HTTP filter (envoy.filters.http.local_ratelimit) with a token bucket of 3 tokens per 10-second window per downstream connection remote address, applied specifically to routes matching prefix '/api/v2/'. The rate limiter returns HTTP 429 with a static response body before the request is forwarded to the upstream Ktor container. Additionally, the Istio PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS, meaning only mesh-internal services with valid SPIFFE identities can reach the pod. The Envoy access log format includes %RESPONSE_FLAGS% which shows 'RL' for rate-limited requests, confirming the filter is active. The local_ratelimit filter is positioned before the router filter in the filter chain, ensuring it executes prior to upstream forwarding.

config.response_on_limit: HTTP 429 with empty body, connection not forwarded
